content.rendered:
A cake fit for the little boss in your life! This Baby Boss-themed cake is crafted with intricate fondant detailing, featuring the adorable and stylish Baby Boss character. With rich layers of moist sponge and velvety cream, this cake is a delightful treat for birthdays and special occasions. Whether it’s for your child or someone who loves the Baby Boss character, this cake adds fun and flavor to any celebration. Surprise your little one with this delicious and visually stunning cake that’s sure to be the highlight of the party!

Product Details:

  • Type: Cream Cake
  • Eggless Cake
  • Weight: 1kg
  • Shape: Round |
  • Flavour: Black Forest | Serves: 4-6 people

 

Care Instructions:

  • Store cream cakes in the refrigerator.
  • Fondant cakes should be kept in a cool, air-conditioned space.
  • Serve at room temperature, avoiding heat exposure.
  • Use a serrated knife for cutting fondant cakes.
  • Decorative elements may have toothpicks or wires—check before serving.
  • Consume within 24 hours for best taste.

 

Delivery Information:

  • Cakes are handcrafted; slight variations in design & shape may occur.
  • Delivery time is an estimate based on availability & location.
  • We attempt delivery only once as cakes are perishable.
  • Address changes post-order are not possible.
  • Actual product may slightly differ from the image shown.
  • Hand-delivered, not shipped via courier.
